source_criterion: Cetuximab CRC: EGFR-expressing, RAS wild type, failed oxaliplatin/irinotecan AND irinotecan intolerance. Head/neck: radiotherapy context with platinum ineligibility. Panitumumab: adult, RAS wild type after fluoropyrimidine/oxaliplatin/irinotecan failure.
limitation: Mutant/unknown RAS exclusion applies to CRC; the separate head/neck context is not excluded by RAS.

source_criterion: Cetuximab ECOG 0–3; panitumumab 0–2; adequate marrow, renal and liver function.
limitation: No invented ANC, platelet, CrCl or LFT numerical thresholds.

source_criterion: Hypersensitivity; mutant/unknown RAS in CRC; panitumumab interstitial pneumonitis/pulmonary fibrosis.
limitation: Separate pulmonary-fibrosis flag added; confirmed ILD stop retained.

source_criterion: Grade ≥3 or intolerable skin toxicity: hold. Fourth severe episode: stop. Recovery is required; the previous actual dose must not be escalated.
limitation: Cetuximab: maximum 2 weeks, recovery to grade ≤2, restart at 250/200/150 mg/m². Panitumumab: 1 or 2 withheld doses, recovery to grade <3, restart at 100/80/60% of the original dose. Lower/missing previous dose requires manual review.

source_criterion: Cetuximab unrecovered at the maximum 2 weeks: stop. Panitumumab unrecovered after 2 withheld doses: stop. Explicit failed-recovery input is independent.
limitation: Cetuximab recovery beyond 2 weeks requires review, without automatic restart. A zero/missing interval does not establish recovery.

source_criterion: Cetuximab: grade 1 slow/supervise, grade 2 slow/treat, grade 3–4 permanently stop; reactions in the first 15 minutes require interruption regardless of grade. Panitumumab: mild/moderate reactions require rate reduction for future infusions; severe/life-threatening reactions require permanent discontinuation.
limitation: No automated pump-rate or resuscitation instructions. Alpha-gal, red-meat, tick-bite and antibody history review added.

source_criterion: New respiratory symptoms: hold/investigate. Confirmed ILD: stop. Eye symptoms: prompt ophthalmology review. Ulcerative keratitis: interrupt or stop.
limitation: Clinical diagnosis and the choice of interruption versus discontinuation remain consultant-led.

source_criterion: Correct magnesium, calcium and potassium; monitor periodically during treatment and monthly for 2 months after the last dose.
handling: encoded correction review + manual testing schedule
limitation: No fabricated magnesium hold threshold; a magnesium value alone cannot establish treatment clearance.

source_criterion: Cetuximab: no expected renal/hepatic/dialysis adjustment. Panitumumab: no expected renal/dialysis or severe hepatic adjustment; no adjustment for mild/moderate hepatic impairment.
limitation: Severe renal impairment input is connected to review; no invented CrCl percentage. No expected adjustment does not establish eligibility.

source_criterion: Severe infected/blistering skin: withhold/review. Severe diarrhoea/dehydration: evaluate renal risk.
limitation: No fabricated numerical hydration or renal hold cutoff.

source_criterion: Specialist benefit/risk assessment and medicine-specific counseling.
limitation: No routine clearance; follow contraception and post-treatment breastfeeding intervals.

source_criterion: FBC, renal function and LFTs: before each panitumumab treatment and regularly for cetuximab. Antibody allergy/red-meat/tick/IgE history. Disease monitoring follows the consultant plan.
limitation: No fixed scan/marker intervals; assessment does not verify test completion.

source_criterion: Cetuximab: 400 mg/m² loading then 250 mg/m² weekly; start 1 week before radiotherapy and end with radiotherapy. Panitumumab: 6 mg/kg every 14 days.
limitation: Infusion duration, rate, filter, diluent, flush, dose >1000 mg exception and anaphylaxis facilities require verification at prescribing and administration.

source_criterion: Cetuximab: antihistamine/steroid before every dose (suggested chlorphenamine 10 mg IV and dexamethasone 8 mg IV 60 minutes before). Panitumumab: premedication not usually required. Both low emetic risk; skin-care policy applies.
limitation: First 2 cetuximab infusions require vital signs and post-infusion observation; monitoring may cease after 2 tolerated infusions according to the source. Premedication, skin plan and delayed-reaction education are not computed.

source_criterion: Current SmPC and interaction database check.
limitation: The regimen engine is not a comprehensive interaction database; unusual combinations require separate assessment.
